name: PLSC 3400
title: Professional Development for Turfgrass Industries
description: Topics include human resource information, communication skills, turfgrass pesticide laws and compliance, labor laws and compliance, bid specifications, resume writing, interviewing, golf course management structures, business ethics, and benefits of professional association membership. Guest lecturers include industry professionals and representatives. Taught with SAPL 240. Formerly offered as SPSS 3400.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to graduate students.
